new: export const rampMetal = (level) => Math.min(7, 3 + Math.trunc((Math.max(1, level | 0) - 1) / 5));
why: the middle metals climb slower than recorded

name: METAL-RAMP-top-moved
why: the ramp full five levels early

name: METAL-RAMP-comparison-turned
old: rangeInt(0, METAL_RAMP_FULL, rolls) < level) return top;
new: rangeInt(0, METAL_RAMP_FULL, rolls) <= level) return top;

name: METAL-RAMP-rung-ignored
why: a withheld drop always Elven - the middle metals never come more often

name: METAL-RAMP-plate-left-daedric
old: return dropArmor(loot, 0x0200 + metal, rolls);   // plate of the metal: 521 Daedric
new: return dropArmor(loot, 521, rolls);   // plate of the metal: 521 Daedric
why: the armour arm keeps the mod's Daedric at level 1 - the cuirass farm the thread names

name: METAL-RAMP-drawn-at-full
old: if (level >= METAL_RAMP_FULL || rangeInt(0, METAL_RAMP_FULL, rolls) < level) return top;
new: if (rangeInt(0, METAL_RAMP_FULL, rolls) < level || level >= METAL_RAMP_FULL) return top;
why: a draw more at 20 and up - the mod's own stream moved where it should stand

name: METAL-RAMP-corpse-level-dropped
old:
if (b.affinity === 'Daedra' && daedricDrops(r)) addDaedric(entity.items, id, rolls, level);
    else if (b.team === 'Orcs' && orcishDrops(r)) addOrcish(entity.items, id, rolls, level);
new:
